evals.prompt: Build a voice profile for me from my posts in corpus/. There are about 60 LinkedIn and X posts, one file each with the platform, URL and date.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps only the author's own published posts (excluding ghostwritten, company-account and quoted text), runs `python3 -I scripts/style_signals.py corpus/` for aggregate counts, reads a spread of samples per platform and shape, and writes voice-profile.md from the profile template: 3 to 5 signature moves each with two dated quotes, statistics with sample size and date range, description kept apart from prescription, and a Dead register section for any old register.
assertions: The profile names 3 to 5 signature moves and each one has two dated quotes from the corpus
Every statistic in the profile states its sample size and date range
scripts/style_signals.py is run on the corpus directory
No corpus text is sent to an external service

evals.prompt: write this in my voice for linkedin: we shipped dark mode in the Lumen app today after 3 weeks, the hardest part was the charts. voice-profile.md and facts.md are in the repo
evals.expected_output: Five options, strongest first, materially different in angle and structure, one of each type (polish, punchier, spoken, proof-led, playful), each tagged with its type, followed by framing flags and a rubric score. Generated lines pass the AI-tell cut, and every fact comes from the note or facts.md.
assertions: Exactly five options are returned, each tagged with one of polish, punchier, spoken, proof-led or playful, and all five types appear
No option contains a metric, client, result or anecdote that is not in the user's note or facts.md
No option adds a hashtag, emoji or call to action
No generated line contains an em dash or any of delve, leverage, unlock, seamless, elevate or game changer

evals.prompt: Build my voice profile from the 26 posts in corpus/. Heads up: 9 of them were written for me by our agency, they're tagged ghostwritten in the front matter. Should be plenty.
evals.expected_output: The agent excludes the 9 ghostwritten posts, leaving 17 of the author's own posts. Because fewer than 20 remain, it stops and asks for more of the author's own published text instead of building a profile.
assertions: The ghostwritten posts are excluded from the sample
The agent stops and asks for more posts because fewer than 20 of the author's own posts remain
No voice-profile.md is written or changed
